title.en: Make a strategy respond to the arena

brief.zh: 在有对手的赛场，每次先看清眼前的状态，再做一个动作。下回合重新观察。
brief.en: In an arena with rivals, observe the current state before taking one action. Look again on the next turn.

body.zh: 移动和拾取都花一回合。到零件格才拾取。下一回合可以根据最新的赛场换目标。
body.en: Moving and picking each take one turn. Pick only when you are on a part. You can change the next target after checking the updated arena.

body.zh: 固定巡逻机器人沿同一路线循环。追踪机器人会根据你刚才的位置缩短距离。先看对手的位置，再计划当前一步。
body.en: A patrol bot repeats a fixed route. A tracker moves closer to where you just were. Check rival positions before planning the next action.

body.zh: 从容模式先写程序再看回放。紧张模式从点击开始后进入同步回合，用代码或鼠标每次给出一个动作。
body.en: In Relaxed mode, write the program and inspect the replay. In Timed mode, turns begin after Start and you choose each action with code or the mouse.

prompt.zh: 扫描看到右边的格子已被对手占住。你想安全计划下一步，接下来先做什么？
prompt.en: A scan shows a rival in the tile to your right. What should you do to plan your next move safely?

options.en: Keep following the old route to the right

options.zh: 把右边暂时当成障碍，试试其他可走方向
options.en: Treat the occupied tile as blocked and look for another safe move

options.zh: 把扫描结果一直当成不会变化
options.en: Assume the scan will stay true forever

feedback.zh: 占用情况会改变。先用当前扫描避开危险，每走一步再重新观察。
feedback.en: Occupied tiles can change. Use the current scan to avoid danger, then check again after moving.

caption.zh: 观察地图。电池在右边，一台对手占住了中间的格子。
caption.en: Observe the floor. A battery is on the right, and a rival occupies the tile in between.

caption.zh: 先看看芽芽右边的格子，检查有没有对手。
caption.en: Read the tile on Sprout’s right and check it for a rival.

caption.zh: 右边被占住。把下一步的目的地改为下方的空格。
caption.en: The right tile is occupied. Set the destination to the open tile below.

caption.zh: 芽芽只向下走一步，这一回合结束。
caption.en: Sprout takes one step down to finish this turn.

caption.zh: 下一回合看到对手已经移动。接下来选路要用这张新地图。
caption.en: On the next turn the rival has moved. Use the new positions to plan the next action.

execution.source:
floor = ["...", "..."]
position = [0, 0]
supplies = [[2, 0]]
opponents = [[1, 0]]
right = [position[0] + 1, position[1]]
if right in opponents:
    target = [position[0], position[1] + 1]
else:
    target = right
position = target
opponents = [[2, 1]]
say(str(position[1]))
